description: This file manages drag and drop actions within a test project tree in the TestLink open source testing platform. It initializes parameters, handles actions such as changing parent nodes and reordering nodes, and interacts with a Tree manager class for these operations.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class responsible for managing tree structure operations such as changing parent nodes and reordering nodes.

methods.name: change_parent
methods.description: Changes the parent of a specified node in the tree.

methods.name: change_order_bulk
methods.description: Reorders multiple nodes in the tree based on a list.
